title: a-loop-a-test-run-starts-is-the-runs
intention: A ground loop a shim starts inside a test run carries the run's test id and collects itself if it fails, so a tester run that starts a loop leaves no unit in the live user manager.
why: Akien 2026-10-05 (/home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md 8g): the unit leak — 'i don't care which way we deal with it. as long as it gets fixed'. The lived symptom: a shim constructed inside a test run starts a ground-loop unit that carries no test id, so no tester stop can find it and it keeps running in the live user manager after the run (measured 2026-10-05: tooth 3 at HEAD 9e04330c, the unit 'active' after the run, killed=[]).
traces_to: Test against live, marked as testing (ruled 2026-09-28, 2026-10-04: every test output carries a testing mark so it can be thrown away); bf3c16162827 and c64adc092835 (a tester run owns and stops what it started); f04d5ef26a48 (the launcher's spelling of the same systemd-run block); Law 7 (outside a run a failed live loop keeps its failed state where a human looks); RULE 1 (the change lives in cairn/tools/base, which spells this argv)
how: In cairn/tools/base/shim.py ensure_ground_loop, after the fixed systemd-run argv and before '--', append --setenv=CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID=<id> and -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed only when CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID is set in the caller's environment; outside a run the argv is unchanged. c64adc092835's stop_its_units then finds the unit through the user manager's Environment record. The setsid fall-through inherits the caller's environment already. Proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py, written red 1/4 at 9e04330c.
falsifier: GREEN when cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py prints four ok lines and exits 0: (1) the unit ensure_ground_loop starts with CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID set carries that id in the user manager's Environment record; (2) that unit's CollectMode is inactive-or-failed; (3) a tester run whose subject calls ensure_ground_loop leaves no unit afterwards; (4) with no test id the unit carries none and CollectMode stays 'inactive'; and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_shim.py and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_shim_starts_the_loop.py stay green. RED if any fails. Wrong intent if a loop started inside a test run must outlive the run.
watchme: none, because (cairn/devices/tester/device.py run_proof) every tester run's validation record already names what its stop reached in evidence killed, so a loop unit the mark lets the stop reach is counted on every seal with no probe
children: none, because the change is one function (ensure_ground_loop) in one file of one component with one proof on disk; the launcher's twin is f04d5ef26a48, PROVED

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: apply exactly the unified diff carried in this ticket's build_patch field (`git apply` from a file holding that text, run in the cairn repo root). It edits only cairn/tools/base/shim.py ensure_ground_loop: the fixed systemd-run argv ends before '--'; when CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID is set it gains --setenv=CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID=<id> and -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed; then '--', 'python3', '-m', _LOOP_MODULE is appended. No other code changes.

D2: SETTLED: the proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py is already on disk, committed red at 9e04330c (1 of 4 at HEAD: tooth 4 green, 1-3 red). After the build it prints four ok lines and exits 0; the regression proofs cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_shim.py and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_shim_starts_the_loop.py each exit 0.

build_patch:
diff --git a/cairn/tools/base/shim.py b/cairn/tools/base/shim.py
index 1955e6c1..32fde280 100644
--- a/cairn/tools/base/shim.py
+++ b/cairn/tools/base/shim.py
@@ -136,8 +136,14 @@ def ensure_ground_loop(now: datetime, *, home: Path | None = None, log: Path | N
             "--working-directory", str(repo_root),
             f"--setenv=HOME={env_home}", f"--setenv=PATH={os.environ.get('PATH', '')}",
             "-p", "SuccessExitStatus=3",
-            "-p", f"StandardOutput=append:{log}", "-p", f"StandardError=append:{log}",
-            "--", "python3", "-m", _LOOP_MODULE]
+            "-p", f"StandardOutput=append:{log}", "-p", f"StandardError=append:{log}"]
+    # inside a test run the loop is the run's (ticket 2120e74dcf44, the launcher's twin f04d5ef26a48):
+    # systemd-run hands a unit the MANAGER's environment, so the run's id is carried by hand where
+    # the tester's stop reads it (the manager's record), and a failed loop of a run collects itself
+    test_id = os.environ.get("CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID")
+    if test_id:
+        argv += [f"--setenv=CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID={test_id}", "-p", "CollectMode=inactive-or-failed"]
+    argv += ["--", "python3", "-m", _LOOP_MODULE]
 
     def run_unit():
         return subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
